scope: Matched local synthetic controls compare receiver declaration preflight and UTF-8 context packet behavior with receipt-native, digest-only checking of bounded file bytes.

comparators.interpretation: The receiver preflight verifies receipt-to-bundle declarations and caller-supplied receiver conditions; it does not make a local-byte observation. The candidate adds that separately bounded observation.
The context packet remains the appropriate tool for digest-checked UTF-8 excerpts and obligation mapping. The candidate supports receipt-bound binary byte checks without returning content.

unique_remaining_use_cases: Verify receipt-bound bytes of binary or non-UTF-8 artifacts under an explicit ignition/ workspace without returning artifact contents.
Add a bounded local-byte observation between a serialized Federation receipt and a separate receiver review.
findings: The byte verifier complements receiver declaration checks and UTF-8 context assembly; the matched controls do not support replacing either existing tool.
Evidence is synthetic and local. It establishes neither real-task quality nor source authenticity, provenance, stable snapshots, scientific validity, safety, or measured cost.
